description: Autonomous Hacking Agent for Red Team

written.description: Runs a red-team engagement from a terminal CLI, with an orchestrator that starts specialist stacks like BloodHound or a C2 server only when the engagement reaches them.

alive.last_commit_message:
feat(launcher): reuse the asset inventory in the scope wizard (#1193)

* feat(launcher): reuse the asset inventory in the scope wizard

Wire internal/inventory into engagement scope entry (create + draft-edit). The
picker opens the stack-postgres inventory best-effort (nil when the stack isn't
up yet — common on a first run) and threads it into collectScope, which:
  - Lookup(zone): reuses remembered assets from prior engagements,
  - DiscoverScope: still runs the live passive query,
  - Record(zone, finds): remembers this run's results for next time,
  - mergeRecommendations: unions remembered ∪ live (deduped, remembered first)
    as the suggestion list.
start.go builds the DSN from POSTGRES_PORT/PASSWORD and passes it to Select.
Every inventory call is nil-safe, so a missing inventory degrades to live-only.

Verified on sec-dev: go build / vet / test (engagement + cmd + inventory) green;
mergeRecommendations unit-tested; inventory storage live-verified in #1192.

* docs(changelog): link inventory-wiring PR #1193
